texts.zh:
[Leader.GetName]确认[from.GetName]上的熔岩海洋含有元素周期表中几乎所有已知稀有金属的极纯形式。

这种高浓度的液态金属汇聚产生狂暴的电磁场，导致熔融金属海啸的频发。

我们利用预测模型确定了海啸之间存在的短暂但有规律的间歇，可以利用来收获这些独特的丰富矿藏。
texts.en:
[Leader.GetName] has confirmed that the lava oceans on [from.GetName] contain exceptionally pure forms of almost every known rare metalloid in our elemental catalog.

This concentrated collection of liquid metals gives rise to highly volatile electromagnetic fields, causing the frequent formation of molten metal tsunamis.

Using predictive modeling, we have identified brief but regular lulls in wave intensity which can be used to harvest these uniquely rich deposits.

# 极端熔岩流 / Extreme Molten Currents

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：Shadows of the Shroud（has_shroud_dlc） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/103_anomaly_categories_extreme_frontiers.txt:33; events/extreme_frontiers_events.txt:81 (extreme_frontiers.110)

## 如何开始 How it starts

熔岩星球可能生成（3级，权重3；需要 has_shroud_dlc）。

Can spawn on a molten planet (level 3, weight 3; needs has_shroud_dlc).

单一结果 extreme_frontiers.110“金属海啸”：星球获得 d_minerals_2 与 d_alloys_2 矿藏，帝国获得每月社会研究加成。

Single result extreme_frontiers.110 "Metallic Tsunamis": the planet gains d_minerals_2 and d_alloys_2 deposits and the empire monthly society research.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一结果，无随机分支，无后续章节。

Single outcome; no random branch and no further chapter.

无文明差异。

No empire differences.
